argument: K-0001 only commits to "raises TypeError if text is None" and otherwise accepts `text: str`, but the plan leaves the behavior for other non-string inputs like `int`, `list`, or `dict` undefined. That is an interface gap implementers and tests can reasonably disagree on, so the contract needs to say whether all non-strings are rejected or only `None` is special-cased.
arbitration: Updated K-0001 boundary to clarify that TypeError is raised for any non-string input, not merely None
